source_text:
Title: Ternwick suspends West Quay rail extension pending review
Published: 2024-03-22

Ternwick Regional Transit Board submitted a proposal for the West Quay Rail Extension on 11 January 2022. The proposed line would connect the West Quay district with Ternwick Central Station.

The board invited public comment from 4 May through 17 June 2022. After the consultation, it revised the alignment on 19 August 2022, moving the proposed West Quay station one block inland. Ternwick Council approved the revised extension on 6 October 2022.

On 21 March 2024, the board suspended the project pending an updated cost review and funding assessment. No construction date has been set.
source_title: Ternwick suspends West Quay rail extension pending review
decision_summary: Ternwick Council approved the revised rail extension in October 2022, but the Transit Board suspended the project in March 2024 pending a cost review and funding assessment.
